newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 4.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 4.0 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Thursday conducted a round of special purchase and resale agreements at 4.0 percent in the money market, traders said.
The central bank intervened after the call loan or overnight lending rate traded at the top of its new 3.5-4.0 percent target range.
The new range has only been in effect since yesterday, when the Bank of Canada lowered short term rates for the eighth time this year.
"The bank just moved yesterday so he just wants to make sure he's waving the flag," said one Toronto-based T-bill dealer. The dealer said there were no policy implications in the move.
After the intervention, the call loan rate continued to trade at 4.0 percent.
